uncertainty: Eight bounded Packagist queries saved 391 hits and 241 distinct package names. Twenty distinct pinned Composer source releases passed the valid two-rectangle SVG control through typed document, dimension, validator, sanitizer, optimizer, or rasterizer APIs; two PHP 8.5 bundled SVG size APIs passed separately. This meets the 20-path working goal, but most registry hits were not inspected, one query stopped at its first 100 of 146 results, and six named leads remain unresolved, including the high-adoption symfony/ux-icons package. Thus the list is not a definitive most-used top twenty. Two Packagist aliases of identical source releases and two non-parser tools were excluded. Shared enshrined, PHP-SVG, dompdf, and librsvg families mean twenty package paths are not twenty independent engines. The safe-svg WordPress helper ran with its default option/filter behavior supplied in the adapter, and the Laravel wrapper ran with an isolated Process facade factory. The older TYPO3 sanitizer ran under PHP 7.4. Bitandblack used pinned PECL Imagick 3.8.1; Choowx used root-pinned sharp 0.35.5; librsvg wrappers used rsvg-convert 2.63.4. Packagist lifetime downloads are package-level adoption proxies within PHP, not SVG API usage. The control covers one simple SVG only; no other SVG features or malformed inputs are claimed.
